components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: An optional date of birth in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When present the server derives the owner's ageBand from it, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last name and address. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Server-derived Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by owners with the same last name and address who opted into a shared household via 'sharesHousehold'. Null when the owner is not part of a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (a missing email or householdId contributes an empty segment). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so a create is rejected with 409 only on an exact match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Server-assigned count of existing owners (at the time this owner was created) that share the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Server-derived numeric membership level fixed at creation - starts at 1, adds 1 when an email is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Server-derived region from the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Server-derived preferred contact channel - 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Server-derived flag - true when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: Server-derived age band from the owner's birthDate, computed as full years against the registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR

## Summary

I made the `householdId` deterministic and reworked how `sharesHousehold` and duplicate detection behave.

**Core change — deterministic household id** (`OwnerHousehold.java`)
- `id(lastName, postcode)` now returns the first 12 hex characters of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)`. Removed the old address-based `sameHousehold` matching.

**Always stamp the id** (`AssignHousehold.java`)
- Now unconditionally stamps `owner.setHouseholdId(OwnerHousehold.id(lastName, postcode))` — no repository scan, no back-fill, no dependence on `sharesHousehold`. Owners with the same last name + postcode converge automatically.

**New household-duplicate block** (`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java` + `HouseholdDuplicateException` + handler + escalation YAML)
- Rejects a create (409) when an existing owner shares the computed `householdId`, **unless** the request set `sharesHousehold`, which bypasses the block so the owner is created as a declared member.
- Wired into `owners.POST.yml` right after `assignHousehold` and before `checkIdentityUnique`.

**Identity check unchanged in spirit** (`CheckOwnerIdentityUnique` / `OwnerIdentity`)
- Still compares the full `telephone|email|householdId` key and is **not** bypassed by `sharesHousehold` — so a full duplicate that also declares `sharesHousehold` (same telephone → same key) still collides (Cp28).

**Declared members aren't flagged** (`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`)
- Returns early with `possibleDuplicate=false` when `sharesHousehold` is set — a declared household member is not a suspected duplicate.

**Docs** (`openapi.yml`) — updated the `householdId` and `sharesHousehold` descriptions to match the new deterministic, always-present semantics.

The behavior now matches every checkpoint: same lastName+postcode → shared id (Cp11/Cp36); second such owner → 409 unless `sharesHousehold` (Cp10/Cp35); declared member created and not flagged (Cp35); household membership drives size while `membershipLevel` stays formula-based (Cp23); full-identity duplicates still 409 (Cp03/Cp25/Cp28).
